topology_note: R1 (10.10.10.1) is the DHCP server for all VLANs. MLS1 is an L3 switch with SVIs. VLAN 10 PCs are on the same subnet as R1. VLAN 40 PCs are on a different subnet behind MLS1's SVI Vlan40 (10.10.40.1).
expected_fault: The ip helper-address command is missing on MLS1's SVI Vlan40 interface. DHCP broadcast DISCOVERs from VLAN 40 clients are not relayed to the DHCP server (R1) on the remote subnet. VLAN 10 works because it is on the same subnet as R1.
source_evidence:
MLS1# show running-config interface Vlan40

 no shutdown

MLS1# show running-config interface Vlan10
interface Vlan10

 ip helper-address 10.10.10.1
